name: storm-coast
description: Example theme set. Nine images in three energy tiers: tier 0 plays under the loudest sections of a song, tier 2 under the quietest. Copy this file, rewrite the prompts, and pass it with --themes.
style: photorealistic cinematic still, extremely detailed, dramatic volumetric lighting, deep atmospheric perspective, 8k, no text, no watermark, no signature, no lettering, no borders

0.prompt: A violent storm breaking over a black basalt sea cliff, enormous wave exploding into spray, forked lightning splitting the sky, spray lit from within
A vast night sky torn by branching lightning above a churning ocean, clouds lit from inside, immense scale and depth
A blazing aurora writhing above jagged snow peaks, curtains of green and violet light, stars behind, monumental scale

1.prompt: Towering sea cliffs half-drowned in drifting mist, shafts of sunlight breaking through, distant surf far below
A wide glacial valley beneath gathering thunderheads, rain sweeping across in visible sheets, low sun catching the far ridge
An ancient forest under heavy cloud, long shafts of light through the canopy, mist between the trunks, deep receding perspective

2.prompt: A calm coastline at first light, still water, soft layered clouds edged in gold and rose, distant headland silhouette, tranquil
A perfectly still mountain lake at dawn, mirror reflection of the peaks, thin mist on the surface, cool blue and pale gold
An open field at dusk under a vast quiet sky, last light on the horizon, faint distant lightning, serene and spacious
